notes.title: Nitrogen Narcosis - Deep Vents/Graphics Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Sedwity here, today I am extremely excited to announce that Deep Vents is here!
With Deep Vents also comes the Graphical Improvements!


New Location-

 Added - Deep Vents, Deeper then your crew has ever gone before at the very bottom of what we can explore in your dollar store dive suits, you and the rest of your crew will have to navigate in near pitch black environments avoiding dangerous volcanic vents heating the water near them to unsafe temperatures! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089124/d98c7d28634ed6999b214abd9e57116cd3370527.png


Player Hazards-

 Added - Temperature Sensitivity! the player now has a threat of heat death, this is indicated with a Thermo Element visible on your visor. if you start to heat up you'll need to move away from the heat source to cool down and if you don't you'll begin to take damage over time as you boil in your suit.


Graphics/Settings-

 Added - Real Time Global Illumination using Ray Tracing! by default this setting is disabled but have 4 levels of quality to choose from! (This setting can be expensive on older hardware)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089124/62cbad62a413fd5fce8829b5b1fcd15f5321151e.png

 Added - Screen Space Reflections, Also using Ray Tracing! this setting as well is defaulted to disabled but just has Global Illumination you'll have the option of 4 quality levels. (This setting can be expensive on older hardware)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089124/938230021a88c4da17d948431ba0ee7a7d7a262d.png




If the update is not available try restarting steam! Of course as always we look forward to your feedback which can be sent to us on Discord, Reddit, or the Nitrogen Narcosis Steam Community Hub!

Discord!
Reddit!
YouTube!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089124/d030131f18b16644600d9f5c0ae443266355ab16.png

notes.title: Future Update - Beached Whale!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Sedwity here again to tell you all about some of the upcoming content and features being added to Nitrogen Narcosis!

Locations-

 We are adding a new location called "Beached Whale." This new location is a Facility set in shallow, rough, uncharted waters where a large containership has run aground and spilled some of its cargo overboard onto the seafloor below! Be sure to watch your head as you walk to the Facility beneath the ship.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089124/750b57687f87c2f17114527389a181328ab88ba4.png 


Entities-

 New - seafloor Crab! The seafloor Crab is a smaller version of the hoarder crab wandering around the outside of the Facility, in the shallow waters, be sure to stay clear of these little guys, as just like their big brothers if you walk in front of them, or steal loot nearby they will become hostile!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089124/4ae8b95753391c95b483e978d57e870077787b87.png

 Changes - Sharks outside of the Facility, especially in Beached Whale are more aggressive toward those who smell. These Sharks will now chase you from further away if you are to stink up their ocean with your blood or anything you may have picked up inside the Facility.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089124/6d76a6413936c05156b884f9dddd368ecc839090.png



As always we look forward to your feedback!

notes.title: Hurricane Milton and Arctic Freeze Release to beta.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Sedwity again The team and I have been discussing and we have decided that with the incoming Hurricane that we have a chance of losing power and or internet too close to the release of Arctic Freeze, we do not want to be unavailable if we are needed post release so we have decided to release Arctic Freeze to the steam PUBLIC_BETA channel for all users right now. We are doing this so if there are any problems that interrupt play users can still freely swap back to the last update without issue. Below are some pictures to show you how to activate the beta. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089124/0b4a85603de5bb2f34ec8f37a02989970bfbba19.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089124/d78447fd1186af7b771077b714dbfb2af134ab9a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089124/a450861a53d24b564fefdb2638e26d288996be46.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089124/6a795affb3f65d5066a48303805b8f056d4658bd.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089124/50c533d134b8d65488ba9f8e7078ee2f505a44dd.png

And now you can close the window and install the update!
Below are all the patch notes for Arctic Freeze, we hope you all enjoy the new features, content, and everything we've left for you to explore, oh and hopefully the waters are calmer for you than they are off our coast!

New Location- 
Added - Arctic Freeze, This new Facility set deep within the Arctic Circle built into the walls of an icy underwater cave is one of the largest Facilities Congo will allow its employees to venture into. Unprepared employees should use extreme cations, the long walk from the Submarine to the Facility can take a lot of oxygen, and the Facility itself is no safer. Some doors inside have completely frozen over requiring the use of a Blow Torch to thaw them open.

New Creature!-
Added - Lice!, “Lice” is a genetic failure derived from a Scorpion, random Crustaceans, an Ant, and an assortment of Sea Anemone. The creature cannot see, hear, or smell, but will react violently to being touched. Once Lice has been touched, they seem to have an innate ability to home in and track their prey using vibrations in the environment. Genetic failures extend from its senses to its ability to walk, with legs easily becoming dislocated from the rest of the body causing them to almost flop around as they hunt. 

Loot-

 Reworked - Loot spawning will now work off of a weighted loot pool, This new system will make more valuable loot rarer and even allows loot to be Facility specific. 


Items-

 Added - Icons to Interaction Info to inform players if an item smells, makes them smell, makes noise, or makes them make noise.
 Added - Blow Torch, This item can be used to "Melt" icy objects, it can also be used to burn Creatures, so make sure to watch where you are pointing it! (This item comes in Black Market and Harbor Variants)
 Added - Dinosaur Toy, This item has a button allowing the toy to "roar" creating a short lasting Decibel effect on the player who uses it, but it is pretty fun to play with according to "Jimmy."
 Added - More Generic Loot, These new loot items include a small wooden statue, a little shark plushy, and a box of beer
 Changed - Player Corpse will now add a persistent Smell to a Player while they are holding the Corpse.
 Changed - Oxygen Tanks can now be used to regain 50% of your total Oxygen Bar.
 Changed - Oxygen Tanks can now be purchased at any shop.
 Changed - Oxygen Tank Sell value to 15 was 20.
 Changed - Flashlights can now be toggled on and off. 
 Changed - Flashlights now have limited battery before they completely die.


Player- 

 Added - Icon to show player when save has occurred.
 Added - Icons for Stamina and Oxygen Meter.
 Added - Players standing in "Noisy Environments" such as the Engineering room will have 
"Reduced" Decibels, This means Entities will not be able to hear you as easy.
 Fixed - Player model leaning really far back that could be seen by other players.
 Changed - Player Smell, Players who smell due to damage will now smell longer depending on how much damage was taken, 
 Changed - Player Decibels to be more forgiving, Decibels will now degrade faster leading to the player having less detection faster.
 Changed - Held Items will point more towards the facing directly but not exactly (This keeps the handheld feel of items like flashlights while allowing them to more viable)


Facilities-

 Reworked - The entire Facility Generation Process, The changes done to the Facility Generation Process allows the Facilities you explore to be larger, more confusing, have more "Special Rooms" (Fish tanks, Engineering Rooms, etc...) and even allow the Facilities to generate in ways they could not before, (completely underwater or completely above water.)
 Reworked - All dungeon types to be more special and less uniform
 Changed - In Facility Seamines now have Damage Falloff and a max range of 5 meters. 
 Removed - Inventory Full movement penalty.


Harbor-

 Added - Selling Machine will now tells players when it can and cant be used.
 Changed - Selling Machine to say "Sell Loot" was "Sell Scrap"


Entities-

 Added - Entities will now make noises on Damage and Death.
 Fixed - Entity Inventory Allowing multiple items in same slot (this allowed the Crab to grab more than one item)
 Fixed - Notso "ticking" and being able to shoot people before being fully spawned in.
 Fixed - Notso "ticking" on clients.
 Fixed - Human Mimic AIAnimation Audio not working.
 Changed - Great White Sharks will now spawn outside of "Deep Shelf" instead of Tiger Shark.
 Changed - Mimics can no longer see.
 Changed - Mimics can now hear.
 Changed - Max amount of Crabs in a Facility to 10 was 25.
 Changed - All entities health to fit better now that we can damage things, (Yes somethings can survive seamines now)
 Changed - "Entity Score" (The metric that is used for what can spawn) will now increase by 5% per extra player in the game. (More entities with more players)
 Changed - Indoor Tiger Shark Entity Cost to 75 was 100. (This allows more indoor Tiger Sharks to spawn.)


General-

 Added - Hovering Social buttons on menu will now give info text.
 Fixed - Voip Objects not Registering properly if they previously existed when trying to register.
 Fixed - an issue that caused the audio bar graph to peak when it wasn't actually at max volume.
 Fixed - an issue that caused player to add less decibels than intended based on the normalized 
range of speaking volumes.
 Fixed - Player dying while using a Console will now release the interaction.
 Fixed - Items shouldn't have a chance of floating after being dropped anymore
 Fixed - Water Lapping sound being audible at all heights inside Facilities that are flooded. 
 Fixed - Reset Save File button not clearing Quota Cache allowing player to load a partially deleted save file.
 Fixed - Items being sold while still being held.
 Fixed - Items being able to be picked up while being sold
 Fixed - Player being able to duplicate items by dropping it while transitioning to Open Water.
 Fixed - Clients Attempting to spawn seamines when they loaded (they couldn't but it would try and waste time)
 Fixed - Very Obvious Tiling on sub inside walls.
 Changed - Items now align to ground client side then sync that position and rotation WITHOUT recalculating.
 Changed - Consoles will now show what they are in interaction info. 



As always we hope you enjoy the update and we look forward to your feedback!

Discord!
Roadmap!
Reddit!
YouTube!

notes.title: Future Update - Arctic Freeze Feature Teaser!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Sedwity here again to tell you all about some of the upcoming content and features being added to Nitrogen Narcosis!


Items-

 Some items can now be used to benefit the player, for example Oxygen Tanks are now able to refill half of your oxygen meter.
 Some items are now limited use, for example flashlights now have a limited battery before you'll need to get a new one, make sure to sell the old ones for a little extra to your team credits!
 We'll also be added new items, some with physical use like being able to hurt the entities, and others that are just good for selling the Congo, a preview image of one of these new items can be seen below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089124/e2cbc168e099b821e723e85fe3e460fc8ef7cd82.png

 The Blow Torch is capable of melting small clusters of Ice and also capable of damaging Entities! Just be careful not to let the flame get to close to your friends.


Locations-

 We will also be adding in a new location, set deep within the arctic circle. Explore a new facility covered in ice hidden within the glaciers. In this icy location Congo Employees will have to face new challenges such as...

 Frozen Automatic Doors, these doors wont open until you thaw them using some form of heat source.
 An extra long and icy trip from the submarine to the facility.


Here is a link to the Feature Teaser Video!
[previewyoutube=IEwuvYv0x2U;full][/previewyoutube]


This is just a few of the things coming with the Arctic Freeze update, we look forward to you all being able to explore everything when the update releases!

notes.title: Minor Fixes and balancing Version EA 0.1.08
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Sedwity here again today with Nitrogen Narcosis Version EA 0.1.08, this update is being released to address a few minor issues as well as to help the balancing of the games flow just a tad.



General-

 Added - Water interactions to ragdolls.

 Fixed - Player dying in sub causing positional data to be messed up.
 Fixed - soft-lock if everyone dies in open water.
 Fixed - Entities not being able to enter airlock while its open.
 Fixed - Airlock controls will no longer show key-bind when not usable.
 Fixed - Airlock dedicated drain and fill buttons showing wrong info text.


Entities-

 Changed - Tiger Shark (OUTSIDE) Collision Detection range to 5 meters was 2 (this should make them less jittery)
 Changed - Arack can no longer smell.
 Mimic-

 Changed - Mimic can no longer hear.
 Changed - Mimic can now smell.
 Changed - Mimic range to care to 12.5 meters was 17.5 meters.
 Changed - Mimic range to forget to 25 meters was 50 meters.

 Notso-

 Changed - Notso time to forget on lost line of sight to 10 seconds was 2 seconds.
 Changed - Notso range to care is now 20 meters was 15 meters. 

 Tiger Shark (INDOOR)-

 Changed - Tiger Shark (INDOOR) range to care to 15 meters was 50 meters.
 Changed - Tiger Shark (INDOOR) range to forgot to 22 meters was 50 meters.
 Changed - Tiger Shark (INDOOR) smell to forget to 2.5 was 5. (they will now take longer to lose you)




Quota-

 Changed - Quota base to be between 375-450 was 250-350
 Changed - Quota increase rate to 30%-40% was 25%-35%
 Changed - Quota will be increased by 25% per player in the lobby.


Player-

 Smell will now deplete over time instead of waiting then removing it all at once.
 Decibels will now deplete over time instead of waiting then removing them all at once.

notes.title: Nitrogen Narcosis Is Released and Version EA 0.1.071b Is Live!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Sedwity from Congo here. 
Today we are releasing Nitrogen Narcosis into the Early Access Stage!

For the first 7 Days of the games release it will be 40% off so be sure to pick it up early and start collecting some loot!

Included below are the patch notes for Version EA 0.1.071b as well as the links to our Discord, Roadmap, Subreddit, and YouTube!

Added - HUD Element to show how much you smell,
Added - Player Damage and Death sound effects,

Fixed - Water in Selling Harbor is now interactable,
Fixed - Spectating not respecting Underwater audio effects,
Fixed - Gap in airlock sub door,
Fixed - Some entities "Touch Sensor" not being appropriately sized,
Fixed - Sharks not triggering Automatic Doors

Changed - Airlock door interactions will now inform player when they aren't usable.
Changed - "Deep Shelf" map so there are more ways from the secondary exit back to the sub,
Changed - Interactions will no longer show use key bind if they aren't usable at the time,
Changed - Position Syncing from server to client to have less interpolation, (this will make entity positions on clients more accurate but less smooth for higher ping players)
Changed - Math that adds smell to player based on damage to be more balanced with the total smell and more punishing with the total time the smell last,
Changed - Captain voice over is now a new Voice Actor.
